svg.title: Fieldty, AI software for construction companies. Second prize at Uniovi Emprende 2026.
svg.text: Backend and DevOps · Second prize, Uniovi Emprende 2026
AI software that turns voice notes, delivery slips and incidents from the building site
into structured information for construction companies. Second prize and a €5,000
award at the final of the University of Oviedo's entrepreneurship programme,
